522:     // in_flight_o
523:     //   Aggregates, over both banks:
524:     //     * AW accepted at the upstream input until the upstream B handshake
525:     //       (covers the whole write, including completion AW/AR accepted by the
526:     //       output and held downstream, i.e. "accepted output pressure")
527:     //     * AR accepted until the upstream R-LAST handshake
528:     //     * W-LAST bursts accepted at the upstream input until the upstream B
529:     //       handshake.  A write is counted by its LAST beat and is NOT tracked
530:     //       by downstream forwarding: a write rejected by a bank (translation
531:     //       error) is consumed internally by that bank's error slave and
532:     //       answered with an upstream B, but it is NEVER forwarded to the
533:     //       completion port.  A forward-based W counter would therefore never
534:     //       decrement for those beats and in_flight_o would stay stuck high
535:     //       forever (phantom non-quiet).
536:     //     * w_partial_q: set when a W burst has started (a non-LAST beat was
537:     //       accepted upstream) and cleared when its LAST beat is accepted;
538:     //       covers the window between the first beat of a burst and its LAST.
539:     //     * both bank controller states (bank in_flight_o = state != IDLE)
540:     //   32-bit counters, asserted bounded / no underflow.  Increment and
541:     //   decrement on the same cycle are netted, so they can never produce a
542:     //   false underflow or a spurious overflow report.
543:     //=========================================================================
544:     logic aw_accept, ar_accept, w_accept, w_nonlast_accept, w_last_accept,

547:     assign aw_accept        = tr_axi_req_i.aw_valid && tr_axi_resp_o.aw_ready;

551:     assign w_last_accept    = w_accept &&  tr_axi_req_i.w.last;
552:     assign b_return         = tr_axi_resp_o.b_valid && tr_axi_req_i.b_ready;
553:     assign r_last_return    = tr_axi_resp_o.r_valid && tr_axi_req_i.r_ready && tr_axi_resp_o.r.last;

555:     logic [31:0] inflight_aw_q, inflight_ar_q, inflight_w_q;
556:     logic        w_partial_q;

558:     always_ff @(posedge clk_i or negedge rst_ni) begin : inflight_counters
559:         if (!rst_ni) begin
560:             inflight_aw_q <= 32'd0;
561:             inflight_ar_q <= 32'd0;
562:             inflight_w_q  <= 32'd0;
563:             w_partial_q   <= 1'b0;
564:         end else begin
565:             inflight_aw_q <= inflight_aw_q
566:                            + (aw_accept     ? 32'd1 : 32'd0)
567:                            - (b_return      ? 32'd1 : 32'd0);
568:             inflight_ar_q <= inflight_ar_q
569:                            + (ar_accept     ? 32'd1 : 32'd0)
570:                            - (r_last_return ? 32'd1 : 32'd0);
571:             inflight_w_q  <= inflight_w_q
572:                            + (w_last_accept ? 32'd1 : 32'd0)
573:                            - (b_return      ? 32'd1 : 32'd0);
574:             w_partial_q   <= w_last_accept    ? 1'b0 :
575:                              w_nonlast_accept ? 1'b1 :
576:                              w_partial_q;
577:         end
578:     end

137:     // Control of the AW handshake
